ChangePasswordRequest.description: A signed-in user changes the password with the current one (F-7 UC6).

ConfirmTotpRequest.description: The first code from the authenticator app, which turns two-factor on (F-11 BR2).

DataExportRequest.description:
A signed-in user downloads their own data (F-16 UC2). The account is the token subject (BR1), so the body
carries only the proof that the person at the keyboard owns it (BR2).

DisableTotpRequest.description: Turning two-factor off needs the current password and a code or recovery code (F-11 BR8).

EraseAccountRequest.description:
A signed-in user erases their own account (F-10 UC2). The account is the token subject (BR1), so the
body carries only the proof that the person at the keyboard owns it (BR2).

PasswordResetTokenCheckRequest.description: Asks whether a reset link still works, without using it (F-7, decision: the page checks on load).

RegenerateRecoveryCodesRequest.description: A current code or a recovery code, which proves the second factor before new codes replace the old ones (F-11 BR7).

email.description: The address that identifies the account.

password.description: The chosen password; the policy is checked by the server (BR2).

acceptsTerms.description: Acceptance of the terms of use.

termsVersion.description: The terms version the page showed.

privacyVersion.description: The privacy version the page showed.

RegisterRequest.description:
What the sign-up form sends. The document versions are the ones the page showed, so the server can
refuse a form filled against texts that have since changed (BR5).

RequestPasswordResetRequest.description: Asks for a reset link (F-7 UC1). The answer never says whether the address exists.

ResendVerificationRequest.description: Asks for a new verification link. The answer is always the same, whatever the address is (BR11).

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Chooses a new password with the token from the reset email (F-7 UC2).

organizerId.description: The exam board that applied the paper (BR3). Required.

noticeYear.description: The year of the notice, from 1990 to the current year plus one (BR4). Required.

position.description: The job the paper selects for; blank is stored as null (BR5).

noticeReference.description: How the notice names itself, such as "Edital nº 01/2026" (BR6).

noticeUrl.description: The official address of the notice, absolute http or https (BR7).

appliedOn.description: The day the paper was applied; not before 1 January of the notice year (BR8).

status.description: One of Draft or Published, by name, ignoring case. Blank means Draft only when adding (BR9).

SaveExamEditionRequest.description:
What the edition form sends (F-35, UC2 and UC3). The status travels as text, not as an enum, so a caller
that sends an unknown value gets its own 400 code (BR9) instead of an uncoded deserialization failure —
the lesson F-33's review left on the organizer. Every struct is nullable with a default, so a missing
field is a validation error and never a silent zero.

issuingAuthorityId.description: The organizer that publishes the notice and sets the rules (BR2). Required.

name.description: The exam's name, 2 to 200 characters, unique inside its issuing authority (BR10).

assessmentType.description: One of PublicServiceExam, Certification, UniversityEntranceExam or Enem, by name, ignoring case (BR6).

scope.description: One of National, State or Municipal, by name, ignoring case (BR7).

scopeDetail.description: Which state or which municipality; required for State and Municipal, dropped for National (BR8).

contentLanguage.description: One of the app's languages, canonicalized (BR9).

SaveExamRequest.description:
What the exam form sends (F-34, UC2 and UC3). The assessment type, the scope and the content language
travel as text, not as enums, so a caller that sends an unknown value gets its own 400 code (BR6, BR7,
BR9) instead of an uncoded deserialization failure — the lesson F-33's review left on the organizer.

name.description: The body's full name, 2 to 150 characters.

acronym.description: The short name, 2 to 20 characters, stored uppercase.

website.description: An absolute http or https address, optional.

SaveIssuingAuthorityRequest.description:
What the add and the edit dialog send (F-34 BR18, v2). The issuing authority has no kind: nothing
filters or groups by one yet, and it arrives when a screen needs it.

name.description: The organizer's full name, 2 to 150 characters (BR8).

acronym.description: The short name, 2 to 20 characters, stored uppercase (BR8).

kind.description: One of ExamBoard, CertifyingBody or University, by name and ignoring case (BR7).

website.description: An absolute http or https address, optional (BR10).

SaveOrganizerRequest.description:
What the add and the edit dialog send (F-33, UC2 and UC3). The kind travels as text, not as the enum,
so a caller that sends an unknown kind gets 400 `organizer.kind_invalid` (BR7) instead of an
uncoded deserialization failure.

SaveRoleRequest.description: Creates or replaces a role (F-9, UC2-UC3): the whole permission set, never a patch (BR4).

SetUserRolesRequest.description: The whole set of roles a user holds after the call (F-9, BR6); an empty set is allowed.

UpdatePreferredLanguageRequest.description: F-8 UC3: the header language switch saves the language alone, so it never touches the name (BR6).

UpdateProfileRequest.description: F-8 UC2: the whole editable profile. A blank name clears it (BR2).

VerifyEmailRequest.description: The raw token from the verification link. It is posted, never sent as a query string to the API.
